core_obligations: Direction (1) to (2): lemma-get-cycles (tag 0H59) gives a completely decomposed proper g_0 over the Noetherian model with g_0^* alpha_0 in the image of equation-cycle-classes-general (tag 0H6V); base change by S' = S x_{S_0} S'_0 transports it to S (proof lines 3177-3184). Direction (2) to (1): approximate S = lim S_i by limits-proposition-approximate (tag 01ZA); descend g, Z_a through the six Limits lemmas (tags 01ZM, 01ZP, 04AI, 07RR, 081F, 05M5) and more-morphisms-lemma-descend-cd (tag 0GTM) to finite stage data whose base change recovers the original; the two pullbacks of alpha'_i along the projections of S'' agree after base change, so S'' maps into the closed equal locus E (lemma-relative-cycles-equal, tag 0H5C), and limits-lemma-limit-contained-in-constructible (tag 05F4) promotes this to a finite stage so pr_1^* alpha'_i = pr_2^* alpha'_i; lemma-descend-family (tag 0H4X) descends alpha'_i uniquely to alpha_i on X_i/S_i, lemma-relative-cycles-h-descent (tag 0H52) places it in z(X_i/S_i, r), and uniqueness forces its base change to be alpha, proving (1) (proof lines 3186-3248).
proof_roadmap: Prove (1) implies (2) by applying lemma-get-cycles on the Noetherian model and base changing to S (proof lines 3177-3184).
Approximate S by finite type schemes and descend g and the Z_a to a finite stage via the named Limits and More on Morphisms lemmas (proof lines 3194-3219).
Force the two projections of alpha'_i to agree using the closed equal locus and the constructible-limit lemma (proof lines 3221-3238).
Descend to alpha_i by lemma-descend-family, verify z-membership by lemma-relative-cycles-h-descent, and conclude by uniqueness (proof lines 3239-3248).
